description: HS code lookup API, no key: product keyword to ranked HS / commodity codes, and any code to its full description chain, import duty (third-country), VAT, preferential rate for an origin country, quotas, anti-dumping and other measures for the UK tariff and the EU Common Customs Tariff. Code validation, non-declarable codes return their declarable children, bulk 50 lookups. Official HMRC data. Usable from AI agents via MCP. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.003/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/hs-code-tariff-lookup.

code.description: code mode: HS / commodity code with 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10 digits; dots and spaces are ignored, e.g. 6109.10 or 6109100010.

market.description: UK = UK Global Tariff (default); EU = EU Common Customs Tariff as published by the UK Trade Tariff Northern Ireland (XI) service.

mode.description: search = keyword to ranked HS/commodity codes; code = full details of one code (duty, VAT, origin rate, measures, or declarable children); validate = check that codes exist and are declarable; bulk = up to 50 queries in one call.

origin.description: ISO 2-letter country of origin, e.g. CN, VN, US. code mode returns the preferential rate and the duty that applies to this origin.

q.description: search mode: product words in English, e.g. cotton t-shirt, lithium battery, roasted coffee.

queries.description: bulk mode: up to 50 objects, each one an input of another mode, e.g. {"mode":"code","code":"8517130000","origin":"VN"}. A failing query returns an error row; the others still answer.

name: hs_code_tariff_lookup
title: HS Code & Customs Tariff API - Official Commodity Codes, Duty & Tariff Lookup
